title: 第2章 父辞女笑，入职
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

里面的东西让他皱起眉头。

是几张照片。

照片里是同一个女人和同一个男人在不同地方见面的场景。

男人个子高瘦，三十多岁，留着一头短寸，面容冷峻。

女的看起来二十多岁，乌黑的披肩长发如同瀑布垂落，白皙的鹅蛋脸巴掌大小，眉目如画、唇似樱桃。

白色女士衬衣被沉甸甸的硕果撑得鼓鼓囊囊，紧身的天蓝色牛仔裤包裹着圆润挺翘的臀瓣和修长的美腿。

既性感又有气质。

男人和女人许景川都认识。

或者说整个青川市，只要最近关注过地方法治新闻的人多半都认识。

女人叫姜欢，一个刚刚死了富豪老爸，得以继承百万家产的白富美。

男人叫廖忠、无政府区流民，因偷渡进十三区抢劫杀人被警方逮捕。

而他杀的人叫姜均，青川市一名身家百万的富商，正是姜欢的父亲。

显然姜钧的死跟姜欢有关系。

“啧，这可真是父辞女笑啊。”

许景川感慨一声。

不过赖德全是怎么弄到照片的？

警长任命书、姜欢和廖忠私下碰头的照片，这两样都不该是一个小流氓头子能搞到的。

可偏偏就出现在他手中。

这个人真是不简单。

是杀？是留？

怎么杀？又怎么留？

都得从长计议啊。

许景川将两个文件袋都装进了箱子里，然后开始搬运起地上的尸体。

出生入死的好兄弟不能白死。

大哥我马上要去当官了。

借你们人头立个功。

…………………

早上九点。

坐落于东城区的青川市警察局开始忙碌起来，人来人往。

人事科科长李万顺在阵阵问候声中进了办公室，早有下属已经给他泡好茶，最新的报纸也放在了桌子上。

他一如既往先脱掉外套挂好。

然后走到办公桌后面坐下端起茶惬意的抿了一口，又拿起报纸

其中一个板块报道的赫然是昨天发生在青川市中心的枪杀案。

枪杀天天都有，不算稀奇。

而本案之所以备受关注。

是因为死者是一位市议员。

“娘的，大庭广众下杀官，最近疯子咋那么多。”李万顺喃喃自语。

“咚咚咚！”

敲门声打断了他的思绪。

“进。”李万顺头也不抬。

一名穿着制服的女警推门而入娇声娇气说道：“李科，有新人报道。”

“带进来。”李万顺随口说道。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What was inside made him frown.

It's a few photos.

The photos show the same woman and the same man meeting in different places.

The man is tall and thin, in his thirties, with short hair and a stern face.

The woman looks to be in her twenties, with long black shawl hair hanging down like a waterfall, a fair oval face the size of a palm, picturesque eyebrows, and cherry-like lips.

The white women's shirt was bulging with the heavy fruits, and the tight sky blue jeans covered her round and perky buttocks and slender legs.

Both sexy and classy.

Both the man and the woman Xu Jingchuan knew each other.

Or in the entire Qingchuan City, most people who have paid attention to local rule of law news recently will know him.

The woman's name is Jiang Huan, a Bai Fumei who has just passed away and her rich father has inherited a million-dollar fortune.

The man's name is Liao Zhong, a refugee from the anarchy district. He was arrested by the police for sneaking into the 13th District to commit robbery and murder.

The person he killed was Jiang Jun, a millionaire businessman in Qingchuan City, who was Jiang Huan's father.

Obviously Jiang Jun's death was related to Jiang Huan.

"Tsk, this is really a father's farewell and a daughter's smile."

Xu Jingchuan sighed with emotion.

But how did Ryder get the photos?

The appointment letter of the sergeant and the photos of private meetings between Jiang Huan and Liao Zhong were both things that a little gangster leader should not be able to obtain.

But it happened to appear in his hands.

This person is really not simple.

Is it killing?Stay?

How to kill?How to stay?

We have to take a long-term approach.

Xu Jingchuan put both document bags into the box, and then began to move the bodies on the ground.

Good brothers who have been through life and death cannot die in vain.

Brother, I am going to be an official soon.

Let me use your heads to make a contribution.

………………

Nine o'clock in the morning.

The Qingchuan Police Station located in Dongcheng District became busy, with people coming and going.

Li Wanshun, the chief of the personnel department, entered the office amid waves of greetings. His subordinates had already made tea for him, and the latest newspapers were placed on the table.

As always, he took off his coat and hung it up first.

Then he walked behind the desk, sat down, took a sip of tea, and then picked up the newspaper.

One of the sections reported a shooting case that occurred in the center of Qingchuan yesterday.

Shootings happen every day, it's not unusual.

This is why this case has attracted so much attention.

It was because the deceased was a city councilor.

"Damn it, killing officials in public, why are there so many crazy people lately." Li Wanshun muttered to himself.

"Dong dong dong!"

A knock on the door interrupted his thoughts.

"Come in." Li Wanshun didn't even raise his head.

A uniformed policewoman pushed open the door and said in a coquettish voice: "Li Ke, there is a new report."

"Bring it in." Li Wanshun said casually.
